Available in two cable lengths: 1 meter and 2 meters. The magnetic alignment experience only applies to iPhone 12, iPhone 13, iPhone 14, iPhone 15, compatible iPhone 16 models, iPhone 17 models, and iPhone Air. Recommended: For faster wireless charging up to 25W — up to 50 percent battery in around 30 minutes for iPhone 17 models when paired with the 30W USB‑C Power Adapter (sold separately). For fast wireless charging up to 15W for iPhone 12 or later with MagSafe when paired with the 20W USB‑C Power Adapter (sold separately). For wireless charging up to 7.5W for iPhone 8 or later with Qi when paired with the 20W USB‑C Power Adapter (sold separately).
